title: Intro to Testing Smart Contracts
description: This guide introduces foundational approaches to testing EVM smart contracts covering unit tests, property fuzzing, and security invariant patterns.

body.raw:
import React from 'react';

# Intro to Testing Smart Contracts

Testing smart contracts mitigates risk, documents intent, and enables safe iteration.

## Approaches

1. Unit tests: assert deterministic logic.
2. Property-based / fuzz tests: explore unexpected inputs.
3. Invariant monitoring: ensure system constraints always hold.

{/* Example code placeholder */}

## Next Steps

Continue with deeper guides on gas profiling and formal verification.
